verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Superset exposes an API, SDK, CLI and MCP server for programmatic orchestration, but nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks. The 'get notified when an agent finishes' feature is an in-app notification, an adjacent feature that does not count as webhooks, and API, SDK and MCP access are developer building blocks rather than event subscriptions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
